verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry or usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a SaaS ATS like Recruitee, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no telemetry or analytics opt-out control. The audit-log note that logs track data changes rather than data access describes an adjacent feature, not a user-facing opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
